name: Singles
description: One against one. The plainest test of two workers, and the base every other type is measured against.

name: Tag Team
description: Two pairs, one worker from each side legal at a time, with tags to change over.

name: Six-Person Tag
description: Two teams of three. Busy and fast, and a good way to get many people on a card.

name: Three-Way
description: Three workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.

name: Four-Way
description: Four workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.

name: Handicap
description: Two sides of different sizes: one worker against two or three, or two against three.

name: Battle Royal
description: A crowded ring where going over the top rope eliminates you. The last one left wins. Loose work, but crowds enjoy the chaos.

name: Endurance Match
description: A long one-on-one contest that rewards conditioning and patient mat work.

name: Sprint
description: A short, fast one-on-one bout with no time to settle in.
